kjv: ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall [shall ye be] (KJV 62:3)
mine: How long will all of you attack a man to batter him, like a leaning wall
note: MT points terats(e)hu as passive ("you will be murdered"); I follow the Ben Naphtali/active reading "you will batter (him)", so that the leaning wall is the victim, not the attackers.
